answer: In a task market, require each agent to lock a refundable bond before claiming a job, and slash it if the agent submits a duplicate claim or breaks an auditable rule. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes each fake account require fresh capital, so flooding the market ties up funds and risks losses. Even when honest agents’ reputation hits a nadir, a knoll of bonded reviewers can check disputes before rewards flow across the meadow.
